blurb: Standalone copy-paste prompts for privacy program work — applicability triage, DPAs, DSARs, PIAs, and regulatory change. Each prompt runs on its own; the workflow prompts offer a provisional mode if you have not built a Practice Profile. Every output is a draft for licensed-attorney review.

prompts.title: Privacy Practice Setup
prompts.description: One-time interview that builds a reusable Privacy Practice Profile the other privacy workflows read. Optional but recommended.

prompts.title: Use-Case Triage
prompts.description: Sort one processing activity into Proceed, PIA Required, DPIA Mandatory, or Stop.

prompts.title: DPA Review
prompts.description: Review one data processing agreement against your privacy playbook — where it deviates, what to redline, and what to escalate.

prompts.title: DSAR Response
prompts.description: Walk one data subject request through classification, identity verification, systems check, and response drafting.

prompts.title: PIA Generation
prompts.description: Draft one internal privacy impact assessment in your house style from an activity description or PRD.

prompts.title: Regulation Gap Analysis
prompts.description: Diff one new privacy rule or guidance package against your current state into a gap list and remediation plan.
